title: Borrowed camera moves: "Not yet"
technique: Viral camera moves (bullet time, dive, overhead flip) go in as video references for key beats.
story: A bikini-store owner gets a refund notification in a slow week.
She starts setting up a discount in her Shopify admin.
Scout, a lime orb, freezes time: "Not yet. There's something you don't know."
Scout takes her into a shopper's call: "You discount every week. I'm just waiting."
Shocked, she deletes all her weekly discounts.
A week later a full-price order lands. "Glad I asked."

shots.what: Macro of her phone among bikinis; refund notification slides in
She picks up the phone, coral bikini in her other hand
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Punch-in close-up, she looks into the lens
shots.line: Sales are so low this week.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: At her laptop, tosses a bikini, starts a discount
shots.line: Maybe it's time for a discount.
shots.speaker: Owner (inner)

shots.what: Bullet time: bikini hangs mid-air, Scout pops in at her shoulder
shots.line: Not yet. There's something you don't know.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: She turns to Scout; camera dives into its glow
Shopper packs her beach bag; call card floats up
shots.line: Sunset bikini, in your cart three times. What stopped you?
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: She folds a towel; camera rises and flips overhead
shots.line: You discount every week. I'm just waiting.
shots.speaker: Shopper

shots.what: Owner stops dead, eyes wide, hand on forehead
shots.line: Oh my god... I'm training them to wait.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: From behind at the laptop: deletes discounts, "Discount deleted" toast
shots.line: You know what? Let's delete all these discounts.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: A week later: full-price order lights her phone; she seals a mailer
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Scout becomes the "o" of the Scout wordmark
shots.line: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
shots.speaker: Scout
